notes: Two routes from Sufyan, each its own group: Amr («عمرو بن دينار، سمع جابرا») and Abu al-Zubayr («أبو الزبير، سمع جابر بن عبد الله») each hear Jabir; they are not one level, since each has its own Companion surface
«وأما عمرو فلم يذكر سليكا» is a remark on Amr's version: left out
Sulayk al-Ghatafani and the Prophet's question are the story; the Prophet's words are the saying
